content.title: First real source prefix, actual output origins and full clear bucket checked
content.text:
Checked code 17437f9eaa004abd27de29ab009740d393a94d3b derives a finite common bound for the first literal real OuterNarrow prefix from the SAME accepted source, original build/stored U and cold initialization. metadata.pending=[] is already in the original resource target. It derives the actual narrowed receipt, returned Post/context, ordinary value and Empty rejection OR live indexed cache/Ready/pending/unchanged-metadata callback. Zero-fuel stop and sourceEmpty are retained. No successful-prefix/context/force/model provider is assumed. This proves only the first prefix; actual shared preparation and whole first-goal child reach remain open.

The source-task component passes 49 in-module probes (old 43 plus six forward execution/resource/work/forecast proofs). It retains the original source seed/shape bounds and actual callback frames. Origins record PAST source observations, not future resources. The six helpers remain private; the public import audit uses existing boundary declarations. Two prerequisite local callback/native Post proofs retain both entry and older full-scope resources when restoring the same captured cache. The full source-task induction still must produce every reachable current state.

Actual shared scan output origins now retain each duplicate position, actual earlier-row prefix/producing visit and exact local/global offset, including earlier outputs after later stop. The actual shared parked-prefix receipt derives the full raw removed bucket, representative-compression/clear, literal direct restart and every indexed raw target/trie with UF-class preservation. This is one scan layer and one actual clear receipt; whole emitted history and earlier-entry-to-later-clear causality remain open. Written-path origins remain scoped to SUCCESSFUL TERMINAL shared children.

Largest missing theorem: ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME original emitted root under ONE compatible assignment for all supported domains, paths, aliases, residuals, readback, parked backward recompletion and all historical removed obligations. The original generated-Type closed/mixed atom closure is still checked for all supplied native fuels; it is not full typing. Keep original typing/depth adequacy/completeness, both defaultLPO/preprocessing language directions, order/multiplicity/lazy demand, exact node-count sizes, counts/weights/training, both rank/unrank inverses, host bounds and compiled Haskell correspondence in scope.

All five public gates PASS: 96,578 aggregate dependencies; 194 explicit reports = 192 standard+2 axiom-free; 5,999 source modules/4,997 direct Audit imports. Source pins unchanged; 8 GiB/zero swap/one Lean thread/no heartbeat increase; only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. Failed auxiliary growth generalization, first source-task draft, publication visibility mistake and all keyword/Except/Boolean/pure repairs are retained without false credit. No Haskell/Cabal/test/Liquid source changed; no new Haskell defect or fix is claimed. Removed 27,149,488 bytes of terminal private objects; raw sources/probes/failures/logs retained; mcfta /tmp at last sample 128,502,744 bytes. Compact immutable checkpoint follows. Goal ACTIVE.
